| # Examples for using the reliability parameters {#examples-for-using-the-reliability-parameters-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                                           |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This chapter uses examples to explain how to calculate the corresponding mean time to dangerous failure (MTTFD) and diagnostic coverage (DC) of the RC. Therefore, the information given in [Reliability parameters of the safety function "system integrity"](reliabilityparameterssystemintegrity.html){.topiclink} and [Reliability parameters of the safety function "external stop switch"](reliabilityparametersexternalstopswitch.html){.topiclink} are used.
